title: 第5章 年轻人不讲武德第6章 玄阴鬼府
slug: 道爷斗法累了西幻炸个鱼怎么了
lines: “没想到这噤声符这么快就用上了”
甩了甩因为长时间蓄力而被灵气撑得有些酸胀的手臂，陈昭快速走出山洞，观察了片刻周围没有别人后，迅速掠走了两位修士身上的物品。
陈昭脱下了原本穿在身上的杂役弟子服装，把两人的衣物拼凑一番，组合成一身完整的没有血迹的版本换上，随后沿着山间小道遁逃而走。
这样即便有其他的正式弟子远远的看到了，也只会认为是同为正式弟子的师兄弟正在赶路吧。
约莫遁逃出四十里地，远离了天门宗的势力范围，陈昭才得以喘口气来。
虽然炼气期修士远强于凡人，但还没到达超凡入圣的阶段，长距离的逃跑也使得陈昭累得不行。
这四十里地可是相当于地球上半程马拉松的距离了，寻常凡人一到两个时辰才能跑完的距离，陈昭半个时辰不到就跑完了，这都是在没有动用灵气的情况下完成的。
果然，不到绝境，都不知道潜力有多大，把人逼急了，除了数学，什么都做得出来。
原本，陈昭准备小睡片刻就立即去寻找离开秘境的方法，可当陈昭睡着的瞬间，他便清醒了过来。
当陈昭睁开眼，自己身处的已不再是秘境之中的旅馆房间内，而是先前那被人追杀所躲入的山洞。
陈昭当机立断收敛声息，随机为自己贴上一枚噤声符，果不其然，洞口外便传来了天门宗弟子的声音。
迅速检视了一番自己的所有物品都一并带出了秘境后，陈昭便决意遁逃。
洞口的两位修士大约只是练气中期的境界，这样的布置是十分合理的，若陈昭修习的是天门宗下发给杂役弟子的功法的话，也会像其他杂役弟子一样，修习出来空有修为而无灵气了吧！
那体内没有多少灵气的他是注定无法战胜这两位正式弟子的。
可陈昭会那么容易让他们得逞吗？
借着噤声符的效果，陈昭开始大胆蓄积灵气，在快要激发之前，一手夹住一枚噤声符向前送出，轻粘在那站位相对靠内的修士身上，随后在其反应过来自己被噤声前激发招式，将其斩杀。
噤声符的效果还是十分出众的，那位修士人都变成两节了，愣是没发出一点声音，陈昭也不敢怠慢，立刻开始第二次蓄力
另一位修士站位较远，为确保一击必杀，陈昭不得不榨出身体内每一丝灵力，所幸还是成功击杀了那位修士。
喘了几口气后，感觉体力有所回复，陈昭吞下一节灵药，一边炼化着灵气，一边继续遁逃起来。
虽然四十里地看起来已经很远了，但万一那天门宗要搜查百里呢？
陈昭一直从白天遁逃到黑夜，大约共逃出了两百里的距离，期间连进食都是在跑路过程中完成的。
这种时候，陈昭才确切感觉到了修士与凡人之间的差距，两百里的距离，凡人在平地上赶路，不吃不喝一直走都需一天一夜，陈昭仅仅耗费半天时间，期间还没算上翻山越岭的难度。
虽然后面赶路的速度没有最开始那四十里那么快，但也远远超越凡人了，毕竟这可是光靠陈昭两条腿在跑啊。
寻了处安歇的地方，陈昭摸出了从那两位修士身上搜刮到的东西。
最重量级的，那自然是从那年轻修士身上夺来的缚灵鞭。
这缚灵鞭陈昭也有所耳闻，所以专门瞄准那修士的脖颈激发天光斩，就是为了避免损坏到这缚灵鞭。
虽和其他法器一般，这缚灵鞭上烙有前主人的神识印记，他人夺得后无法使用，可毕竟主人已死，破解这神识印记不过是水磨工夫而已。
两个时辰后，陈昭便成功抹去了缚灵鞭上的神识印记，烙上了自己的，顿时，这条长鞭变得得心应手，虽未习得辫法，却也能如臂使指。
陈昭抖鞭而出，这缚灵鞭快如闪电，击打在空气上，发出惊雷般的响声。
收回鞭子后瞄准一棵巨木再次甩出，随着啪的一声，木屑飞扬，巨木应声而断。
不愧是中品法器，即便不以攻击力见长，也有着强劲的伤害。
陈昭感慨道。
放在从前，下品法器都是陈昭这炼气小修想都不敢想的存在，常规的筑基修士能有一两件中下品法器用就已经很好了，那些能用到金丹期的上品极品法器更是罕见。
现在一件中品法器到手，只要不碰到那些大家族出来的法器随便用的天骄修士，在炼气期，陈昭基本算得上是横着走了。
果然，老话说的好啊，人无横财不富，马无夜草不肥，还是得感谢这位好心人呢！
这缚灵鞭唯一的缺点便是害怕炼体修士，毕竟炼体修士修习的气血完全不受缚灵鞭的限制，只会落得个鞭子被撕碎的下场。
不过据陈昭所知，这玄清界主流的修习模式均是气修，或者被称为灵修，体修门派在千余年前早已没落，终归是炼体大药不如远古那般繁多，现存的体修也大多是零碎的散修。
收起缚灵鞭，陈昭开始查看起夺得的两只储物袋，一只是成为正式弟子后宗门公发的标准储物袋，是那年长修士的，另一个看来是自购的或者是家族给的，不消说自然是那年轻修士的。

content_en:
"I didn't expect this silencing charm to be used so quickly."
Shaking off his arms, which were a little sore from the spiritual energy due to long-term accumulation of energy, Chen Zhao quickly walked out of the cave. After observing for a moment that no one else was around, he quickly snatched away the belongings of the two monks.
Chen Zhao took off the handyman disciple's clothes he was originally wearing, pieced together the clothes of the two of them, put them on into a complete version without blood stains, and then fled along the mountain trail.
In this way, even if other formal disciples saw it from a distance, they would only think that their fellow formal disciples were on their way.
After Yue Mo escaped forty miles and was far away from the Tianmen Sect's sphere of influence, Chen Zhao was able to take a breather.
Although the monks in the Qi refining stage are far stronger than ordinary people, they have not yet reached the stage of transcendence and sainthood, and Chen Zhao was exhausted from running away for a long distance.
These forty miles are equivalent to the distance of a half-marathon on earth. A distance that ordinary mortals can run in one to two hours, Chen Zhao finished in less than half an hour. This was all done without using spiritual energy.
Sure enough, until you are in a desperate situation, you don't know how much potential you have, and when you are pushed to the limit, you can't do anything except mathematics.
Originally, Chen Zhao was going to take a nap and immediately find a way to leave the secret realm, but the moment Chen Zhao fell asleep, he woke up.
When Chen Zhao opened his eyes, he was no longer in a hotel room in a secret realm, but in the cave where he had been hunted before.
Chen Zhao immediately calmed down and randomly affixed a silencing charm to himself. Sure enough, the voices of Tianmen Sect disciples came from outside the cave entrance.
After quickly checking all his belongings and taking them out of the secret realm, Chen Zhao decided to escape.
The two monks at the entrance of the cave are probably in the middle stage of Qi training. This arrangement is very reasonable. If Chen Zhao was practicing the exercises issued to the handyman disciples by the Tianmen Sect, he would be like other handyman disciples and would have achieved nothing but no aura!
He who didn't have much spiritual energy in his body was destined to be unable to defeat these two formal disciples.
But will Chen Zhao let them succeed so easily?
Taking advantage of the effect of the silencing talisman, Chen Zhao began to boldly accumulate spiritual energy. Before it was about to be activated, he held a silencing talisman in one hand and sent it forward, sticking it lightly to the monk who was standing relatively inside. Then he activated a move and killed him before he could react that he had been silenced.
The effect of the Silence Talisman was still very outstanding. The monk had already turned into two knots and did not make any sound. Chen Zhao did not dare to neglect and immediately started to charge up the power for the second time.
The other monk stood further away. In order to ensure a sure kill with one strike, Chen Zhao had to squeeze out every ounce of spiritual power in his body. Fortunately, he succeeded in killing that monk.
After taking a few breaths, he felt that his physical strength had recovered. Chen Zhao swallowed a section of the elixir and continued to escape while refining his spiritual energy.
Although Forty Miles seems far away, what if Menzong wants to search Baili that day?
Chen Zhao fled from day to night, covering a distance of about two hundred miles. During this period, he even ate while running.
At this time, Chen Zhao truly felt the gap between monks and mortals. The distance was two hundred miles. It would take a day and a night for mortals to travel on flat ground without eating or drinking. Chen Zhao only spent half a day, not counting the difficulty of climbing over mountains and ridges.
Although the speed of the subsequent journey was not as fast as the first forty miles, it was still far beyond that of ordinary people. After all, Chen Zhao was running on his two legs alone.
After finding a resting place, Chen Zhao took out the things he had collected from the two monks.
The most important thing was naturally the spirit-binding whip that was taken from the young monk.
Chen Zhao also heard about this spirit-binding whip, so he specifically aimed at the monk's neck to activate the Sky Light Slash, just to avoid damaging the spirit-binding whip.
Although like other magic weapons, this spirit-binding whip is branded with the spiritual mark of its former owner and cannot be used by others after it is obtained. However, after all, the owner is dead, and cracking the spiritual mark is just a matter of time and effort.
Two hours later, Chen Zhao successfully erased the spiritual mark on the spirit-binding whip and branded it with his own. Immediately, the long whip became handy. Although he had not learned how to braid it, he could use his fingers like an arm.
Chen Zhao shook his whip and came out. The spirit-binding whip was as fast as lightning, hitting the air and making a thunderous sound.
After retracting the whip, he aimed at a giant tree and swung it again. With a snap, sawdust flew into the air and the giant tree broke.
It is worthy of being a mid-grade magic weapon. Even if it is not known for its attack power, it still has strong damage.
Chen Zhao sighed.
In the past, low-grade magic weapons were something Chen Zhao, a minor Qi refining cultivator, could not even imagine. It was good enough for a regular foundation-building monk to have one or two middle- and low-grade magic weapons. It was even rarer to have top-grade magic weapons that could reach the golden elixir stage.
Now that he has a mid-grade magic weapon, as long as he doesn't encounter those Tianjiao monks who use the magic weapons from big families casually, Chen Zhao can basically walk sideways during the Qi refining period.
Sure enough, as the old saying goes, a man is not rich without windfall, and a horse is not fat without night grass. We still have to thank this kind person!
The only shortcoming of this spirit-binding whip is that it is afraid of the body-refining monks. After all, the energy and blood practiced by the body-refining monks are not restricted by the spirit-binding whip, and they will only end up with the whip being torn into pieces.
However, as far as Chen Zhao knows, the mainstream practice mode in the Xuanqing world is Qi cultivation, or spiritual cultivation. The physical cultivation sect has declined more than a thousand years ago. After all, there are not as many great medicines for body refining as there were in ancient times, and most of the existing physical cultivation is fragmented.
Putting away the spirit-binding whip, Chen Zhao began to look at the two storage bags he had obtained. One was a standard storage bag issued by the sect after becoming an official disciple. It belonged to the older monk. The other seemed to have been purchased by himself or given by his family. Needless to say, it belonged to the young monk.
